Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorFixedSpeedControl

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorFixedSpeedControl
public final class CompressorFixedSpeedControl extends Object
Operating point of a constant-speed centrifugal compressor that has to meet a required discharge pressure.

Many compressors cannot change speed (motor on a fixed gear, no VFD). The speed solvers of CompressorShaft then do not apply: the chart gives one head per flow, and the plant meets the pressure set point by moving along the curve. This class reproduces that, on the real chart of the member:

  • the highest head without leaving the curve is at the process flow, or at the anti-surge control line if the process flow is below it; if that pressure is below the requirement the member has a head deficit;
  • with surplus head, recycle raises the through-flow along the curve until the chart head equals the requirement; the through-flow, recycle fraction, shaft power (through-flow at the real head and chart efficiency) and discharge temperature are those of that point, not of the process flow;
  • if the chart still has surplus head at the stonewall flow, recycle cannot remove it and the surplus has to be throttled (FixedSpeedControlResult.Status.THROTTLE_REQUIRED); the power is then that of the curve at the lowest allowed flow.

Every chart evaluation runs a deep copy of the member (Compressor.copy()) at the trial flow, so the molecular weight correction, inlet guide vanes and efficiency model of the member are used exactly as in the flowsheet, and the member and its streams are not changed. The recycle gas is taken to return to the suction at the same state (cooled recycle, same composition), so the through-flow is a pure scaling of the suction stream.

Typical use: set the speed of the member (or run a CompressorShaft at fixed speed), call evaluate(Compressor, double) for each stage and each gas (for example a changing flare-gas share), and compare the status, recycle, power and temperature with the limits of the machine.

  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      public static FixedSpeedControlResult evaluate(Compressor member, double requiredDischargeBara)
      Evaluate how a constant-speed member meets a required discharge pressure.
      Parameters:
      member - the compressor, already run, with a performance chart in use and a fixed speed set
      requiredDischargeBara - required discharge pressure in bara
      Returns:
      the classification and the controlled operating point; FixedSpeedControlResult.Status.NOT_EVALUATED (never an exception) when the member has no chart in use, no speed, no flow or the chart run fails
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if member is null or the required pressure is not positive

    • throttled

      Result for a member whose surplus head cannot be removed by recycle.
      Parameters:
      probe - the member copy
      name - member name
      speed - member speed in rpm
      required - required discharge pressure in bara
      pHigh - discharge pressure at the lowest allowed flow in bara
      q0 - process flow in m3/hr
      qMin - lowest allowed through-flow in m3/hr
      controlFlow - anti-surge control-line flow in m3/hr
      hasStoneWall - whether the stonewall flow is known
      stoneWall - stonewall flow in m3/hr
      m0 - process mass flow in kg/hr
      Returns:
      the throttle-required result at the lowest allowed flow
